description: The recent posts a company page shows logged-out visitors (about 10), with engagement{likes,comments}. Flat 1 credit. Costs 1 credit. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response (numeric offset, e.g. 5). A null nextCursor means the end of the list. Only the recent posts LinkedIn shows logged-out visitors (about 10) are available.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 100). Only the ~10 posts the public page shows are available. Flat 1 credit.

url.description: LinkedIn company URL, e.g. https://linkedin.com/company/slug. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: linkedin_company_posts
